subject: DPA & SCC module selection — follow-up from discovery call
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Barnes <emma.barnes@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: DPA & SCC module selection — follow-up from discovery call

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for taking the call this morning — great to hear more about Acme's use case (high-volume embedding lookups + PII redaction pipeline). Per our discussion, you had a few items you wanted clarity on around GDPR/DPA and SCCs before you can move to legal review. Quick summary and proposed next steps: 

• What we covered: Redwood's hosting modes (hosted vs dedicated), data-in-transit/storage details, and where customers typically sit as controller vs processor.
• Outstanding asks from Acme: 1) Redwood's standard DPA, 2) SCC module mapping for EU customers, 3) SOC 2 Type II evidence & HIPAA stance if relevant.

Attached is our draft DPA (Redwood_DPA_v1.pdf) and an SCC module mapping spreadsheet that shows which modules we recommend given your flow. I copied our security lead (rishi_malhotra) and legal (priyom_das) to help align on the controller/processor language.

Next steps:
1) Emma/Acme: confirm whether Acme will be controller for the dataset in question and whether you need the full SCC modules for controller-to-processor (we flagged Module 2 + 4 as likely).
2) Rishi: confirm current SOC 2 status, any carve-outs, and whether the SOC report can be shared under NDA.
3) Priyom: propose any DPA redlines upfront so Acme can start internal legal review.

Can you confirm timelines for legal review? Would next Wednesday (6/17) for a quick sync with Acme legal work?

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v1.pdf]
[Attachment: SCC_module_mapping.xlsx]

From: Emma Barnes <emma.barnes@acme.com>

Subject: Re: DPA & SCC module selection — follow-up from discovery call

Thanks Marissa — that summary is perfect.

A couple of quick clarifications from our side:
• Acme will be the data controller for customer PII; we expect Redwood to act as processor for inference and storage.
• For SCCs, our privacy team usually requests Module 2 (Controller to Processor) plus Module 4 (Additional safeguards) when using hosted services. If you think Module 2 alone is sufficient, flag that and we'll follow Acme process.
• SOC 2: we can share the SOC request form — if you can confirm ability to share the Type II under NDA, we'll kick that through.

We should be able to aim for a legal review the week of 6/22 — 6/17 might be tight on our side but let me check and confirm.

Emma Barnes

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Emma Barnes <emma@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA & SCC module selection — follow-up from discovery call

Hi all,

Quick update on security posture / docs: 
• SOC 2 Type II (Security) completed for 2025 — we can share the report under a standard mutual NDA. I've attached the 2025 cover letter and the InfoSec summary; full report distribution requires signature of our standard NDA.
• SCC recommendation: for hosted inference where Redwood processes embeddings and persists short-term KV cache, Module 2 (Controller to Processor) + Module 4 (Onward Transfers & supplementary measures) is the conservative pick. Module 2 alone is sometimes accepted if the customer restricts storage and we enable strict retention/auto-delete. Given Acme's mention of PII and EU residency, Module 2+4 is appropriate. See SCC_module_mapping.xlsx for mapping to our controls.
• HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA workloads on Dedicated or Private deployments with BAAs. For hosted (multi-tenant) we do not sign BAAs in our standard offering — if Acme requires HIPAA-level protections, we can discuss Dedicated capacity or Private deployment options.

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_report_2025.pdf (cover & summary), SCC_module_mapping.xlsx

Next steps:
1) Priyom — once we have DPA redlines, we can propose controller/processor text and the SCC appendix (we have templates for Module 2 + 4).
2) Marissa/Emma — if you want Module 2+4, we'll prepare the SCC appendix and conditional safeguards list.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_report_2025.pdf]
[Attachment: SCC_module_mapping.xlsx]

Subject: Re: DPA & SCC module selection — follow-up from discovery call

Hi everyone,

I reviewed Redwood_DPA_v1.pdf and left a few high-level notes: 
• Controller/Processor alignment: we'll confirm the processor obligations section to explicitly cover cache retention limits, deletion upon request, and subprocessor list + notice period.
• SCCs: we'll include Module 2 + Module 4 as an appendix and call out additional safeguards for onward transfers (encryption at rest + role-based access).
• Liability / indemnity: expect Acme legal to ask for narrowing of liability caps for breach tied to our negligence — we'll propose a carve-out for wilful misconduct and maintain a standard capped limit otherwise.
• SOC 2 sharing: we'll permit sharing the full Type II under our mutual NDA. I'll attach a mark-up and propose a short 1-page summary for Acme legal to speed review.

Plan: I'll send redlined DPA (tracked) by EOD Friday 6/12. Rishi — can you prepare the SCC appendix skeleton (Module 2+4) so we can include it with the redline? Emma — if you can confirm by EOD Friday whether Acme wants Module 2+4 or Module 2 only, that would help prioritize.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v1_redline.pdf (pending)]
